subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S63TU across all 2 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S63TU is a specialist engine — only fitted to the X5 M and X6 M high-performance SUVs.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with hybrid-system ancillaries additionally accounted for on MHEV/PHEV applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The S63TU shares the hot-vee design of its predecessor, with valve seal and coolant system wear reported as areas to monitor. We don't assume any pattern for any specific S63TU application — we diagnose the engine in front of us, not by a reputation.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed S63TU rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
